counterfactuals.swapped: Physical sensor responses fixed; all ego and teammate modality labels exchanged.
counterfactuals.neutral: Physical sensor responses fixed; every modality lookup replaced by the mean learned embedding.

representation.attention: First transformer layer, ego query, per-head pre-residual self-attention.

notes: All conditions use paired environment seeds and policy-sampling seeds.
The hidden range-response law is never exposed in the RSO observation.
UMAP and attention associations are exploratory; the label interventions provide the functional test.
